_doc: NONASK-1103 S1b seed/fallback for the proposed vera_entity_registry table (db/migrations/pending/014-DRAFT; migration 014 is superseded by the planned combined lists-to-DB migration 016, not applied). Owner-curated; exact hosts only (no wildcards); only state=active rows count. App code never writes rows; no user text becomes a row.
_terms_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-04 in part: the sentence 'unknown or missing means links_only' is the R-042 wording; R-050 (read unless restricted) governs, see _verification_note. Original: Owner decision 2026-11-03 (honour site terms): terms_verdict is allow | links_only | unknown, with terms_evidence pointing at the evidence record. Pages are fetched ONLY where terms_verdict=allow AND robots.txt permits automated access; unknown or missing means links_only. Seeded from work/NONASK-1103/entity-hosts-evidence.md (Google Cloud allow, host docs.cloud.google.com since cloud.google.com/docs 301-redirects there; AWS, Nvidia, Azure links_only).
_calibration_note: Curated list, not a tuned number. 2026-11-04 (OD-OL-1): the 10 active rows were verified against live sites by OFFICIAL-REGISTRY-VERIFY-1104 (work/OFFICIAL-REGISTRY-VERIFY-1104/registry-verification.md) and signed off by the owner; each row carries `verification`. Domain identity rests on each entity's own pages (no WHOIS); ai.txt/noai mostly unchecked. Draft and suspended rows remain unverified proposals. match_case=true on common-word names (Azure, Google, AWS) so lowercase everyday use does not match; exclude_next lists lowercase words after which the name is not the entity (e.g. 'Amazon rainforest'). Entity-detection precision (gate G8) is UNCALIBRATED.

_context_note: NONASK-1103 stream S disambiguation: full_aliases count alone; otherwise a name or parent hit counts only with a context term (curated list, whole-word, phrases allowed) and after generic_phrases are removed. No numeric threshold. Curated data, UNCALIBRATED; extend from reviewed false hits.
_permissions_note: Owner decisions R-049/R-050 (2026-11-03): three per-source gates read by vera/source_permissions.py. access_verdict (read), derivative_verdict (use for the answer), ingest_verdict (store), each allow | forbid | unknown with *_evidence. Unknown = allowed for read and use; ingest also needs an explicit storage licence. forbid on access means the host is never fetched. terms_verdict/terms_evidence (I-SL) are unchanged. Seeded from work/NONASK-1103/entity-hosts-evidence.md.
_verification_note: OD-OL-1 (owner, 2026-11-04) signed off the registry table at work/OFFICIAL-REGISTRY-VERIFY-1104/registry-verification.md: read-permitted 4 (Google Cloud, Kafka, Pulsar, Slack incl. docs.slack.dev), link-only 6 (AWS, Nvidia, Azure, Snowflake, Teams, Zoom on support.zoom.com), exclude 0. Owner qualification, verbatim: "Treat the access verdicts as operational policy decisions, not definitive legal determinations of permitted AI use." Deny All (owner standard 2026-11-04): allowed_paths per exact host ({exact:[...], prefix:[... ending '/']}) is the only path rule; a path is read only if, after normalisation (percent-decode once; deny anything still encoded, non-ASCII, a query, ';', backslash, empty/'.'/'..' segments), it equals an exact entry or starts with a prefix. Everything else is link-only. path_case_insensitive=false: paths compare case-sensitively. avoid_paths is kept as documentation only. robots.txt is still enforced per hop. H5 (OD-1106-HITL, owner 2026-11-06): three authority rows added (FEC, Census Bureau, EAC; static pages only), status owner_decided_unverified_paths: robots.txt and the path layout were not fetched when they were added. congress.gov is deliberately absent (blocks AI agents). State election-office sites are absent until their terms are read.
